title: a MainSystem does not keep its SystemContainer alive
author: Claude-JG
description: SC.AddSystem() returns the MainSystem with return_value_policy::reference: a script that keeps mbs but drops SC (del SC, or SC created inside a function that returns mbs) works on a system the container has deleted. GetGeneralContact keeps its system alive since #1512 (reference_internal); the same for AddSystem/GetSystem would tie mbs to SC. Check what else depends on the current behaviour (SC.Reset, the renderer) before changing it.
